resources.string: Connect to wireless debugging on this phone to read open WeChat articles.
Pairing successful. Use “Check connection” to verify wireless debugging is available now.
Check the connection to confirm it is available.
Complete pairing on this phone. No computer or split screen needed.
1. Turn on Wireless debugging.\n2. Tap Pair device with pairing code.\n3. Open notifications and enter the six-digit code in the DSH notification.

A pairing notification will appear and Developer options will open. Enable Wireless debugging, choose Pair device with pairing code, keep the dialog open, then enter its code in the notification.\n\nDSH discovers local ports automatically and does not save the code.
Open Pair device with pairing code in Wireless debugging.
Keep the system pairing dialog open and enter its six-digit code here.
Verifying the pairing code. Please wait.
Paired. Looking for the local connection port.
Wireless pairing is complete. Return to DSH to read an article.
Open a new pairing code dialog and start pairing again from DSH.
Enter six digits. The code is valid only while the current system dialog is open.
Timed out. Return to DSH to start again.
Cannot discover local services. Check wireless debugging and local network permission.
Allow DSH notifications and the Wireless pairing channel in system settings to enter the code from notifications.
Notification or local network permission is missing. Enable it in system settings and retry.
Developer options could not be opened. Enable them manually in system settings.
Wireless pairing requires Android 11 or later.
Connection failed. Check wireless debugging; if the port changed, pair again or update it manually.
Enable WeChat XWeb debugging and open an article first.
Could not read the article. Check the connection and open a debuggable WeChat article.
For manual ports or legacy TCP ADB.
Enter a valid connection port (1–65535). Proxy port 15555 is not supported.
Stop DSH connections without changing system debugging settings.
Pairing was saved, but connection failed. Check wireless debugging or update the connection port in Advanced.
Keep WeChat in front. Tap to view progress or stop.
